decisions.reason: Rye country bread is very close to the firm's existing bakery knowledge base, so absorptive capacity is high and there is little sign that it could not be refined and sold within the core assortment.
The premium raisin Christmas stollen fits the firm's established capabilities and the reported gold medal is strong early validation that management can build on and commercialise successfully.
A rye mixed bread with seeds is an incremental extension of familiar bread expertise, making it easy for the firm to interpret demand and improve through routine product adaptation.
Dark barley malt rye bread remains closely related to the firm's bread competences, though its more distinctive flavour profile gives it slightly more market risk than standard rye lines.

Marzipan Christmas stollen is still well within the firm's seasonal baking know-how, but without explicit performance signals it carries somewhat higher portfolio-pruning risk than the award-winning raisin variant.

Ancient grain bread draws on adjacent grain-processing knowledge that the firm can absorb and develop, and its positioning as a new master product suggests management is likely to give it time to learn and adjust.
